{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}A dark aura surrounds you, inflicting {c_important}Decrepify{/c} and {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} on enemies around you and increasing your damage to Close enemies by {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Curses{/c} inflicted this way spread to surrounding targets every second.
